subject: AtlasHealth RFP: request for evaluation credits and bake-off logistics
messages:
From: Sasha Brown <sasha.brown@atlashealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: AtlasHealth RFP bake-off — request for evaluation credits and infrastructure details

Hi Monica,

Following up on our conversation last week — AtlasHealth is running an RFP-style bake-off across three vendors (Redwood, GoliathAI, and a smaller open-source stack) to validate latency/cost for our clinical summarization workload. Procurement wants written confirmation of what evaluation support and credits each vendor will provide so it can be included in the RFP packet.

Our asks are:
- 2-week isolated evaluation window (dedicated endpoint)
- ~50k tokens per model for initial benchmark runs + ability to scale to 200k tokens if results look promising
- Evidence of logging/audit for requests (SOC2-relevant)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a promotional credit allocation and a short statement of terms (no-publication clause possible)? Attached is the RFP scope for context.

Thanks,
Sasha Brown
Director, AI Platform Evaluation
AtlasHealth
[attachment: Atlas_RFP_bakeoff_scope.pdf (pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Brown <sasha.brown@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth RFP bake-off — request for evaluation credits and infrastructure details

Hi Sasha,

Thanks for the scope — we can absolutely support an isolated evaluation. Proposed support from Redwood:
- 50,000 free token credits allocated up-front for the bake-off (can be increased to 200,000 on request pending internal approval)
- Dedicated evaluation endpoint with access controls for 2 weeks
- Audit/log export (sample SOC2 artifact) and a short terms addendum that includes a no-publication clause by default — we can remove it if you need public benchmarking.

Ill need internal sign-off for the 200k bump and will loop in my manager & legal for the terms addendum. If that sounds good Ill send the promo code and a kickoff invite for Wednesday.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Monica Patel
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -04:00
Subject: FW: AtlasHealth RFP - request for evaluation credits (need approval)

Team,

AtlasHealth (large payer) is running a competitive bake-off. Theyve asked us to commit to:
- 50k promo credits immediately, with the option to scale to 200k tokens if the initial runs look promising
- 2-week dedicated eval endpoint
- a short addendum with a no-publication clause (they may request public results later)

My recommendation: approve the 50k credits + the endpoint immediately (low cost, high strategic upside). Approve the 200k contingency only with a signed mutual action plan and deal_id (ATL-2026-09-001) and a capped reimbursement or usage limit to avoid open-ended exposure. Legal will draft a short addendum; Id prefer we keep no-publication by default for this RFP.

Can you confirm? Im also including the proposed promo terms in the attachment.

Thanks,
Monica

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: FW: AtlasHealth RFP - request for evaluation credits (need approval)

+1 to Monicas recommendation. Approve:
- 50,000 token promo allocation today (no impact to quota admin; promotional bucket)
- Dedicated endpoint for the 2-week window
- Contingent approval for up to 200,000 tokens provided Atlas signs the mutual action plan (deal id ATL-2026-09-001) and we include a publication clause requiring Redwood consent.

Operational notes for onboarding team: create promo code ATL-50K-SEP26, set expiry 2026-10-31, track in HubSpot HS-87214. Finance: flag this as promotional credits for Q3 partner KPIs.

Marissa — can you confirm finance ok with this approach and that we dont need additional billing controls?

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth RFP bake-off — request for evaluation credits and infrastructure details

Hi Sasha — great to connect. Quick update:

Per internal approvals, were able to provide the following for the AtlasHealth bake-off:
- 50,000 token promo credits delivered immediately via promo code ATL-50K-SEP26 (expires 2026-10-31)
- Dedicated evaluation endpoint (2 weeks) and assistance from our onboarding team
- Audit/log export and a short terms addendum; we include a default no-publication clause (we can discuss modifications if you need public benchmark results)

Attached is a one-page promo terms doc and Ive created a HubSpot record HS-87214 and deal ATL-2026-09-001. If youd like to scale to 200k tokens after the initial runs well need a signed MAP and confirmation of scope.

Next steps:
1) Confirm attendee list and desired kickoff time — Im proposing Wednesday 10:00 AM ET for a 30-minute kickoff.
2) Ill provision the promo code and endpoint and share access details in a separate email from onboarding (ccd).

Appreciate the opportunity to participate in the bake-off — were looking forward to showing Redwoods cost/latency advantages.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
